segments.title: Hot Salad Freestyle & Sub Marathon
segments.notes: Hype Train opens with an extended freestyle about hot salad, acknowledges a wave of gifted subs (41-month streaks), and derails into culinary metaphysics before yielding to the news desk.

segments.title: Iran Talks, Texas Protest Charges, & Crum Dick Punch Setup
segments.notes: Blackwell and Rick cover Iran denying direct talks after Trump's 48-hour strike deadline, Texas terrorism charges against antifascist protesters, and Blackwell confirms the gorilla people-mover is being readied for the Crum Dick Punch.

segments.title: PolyMarket Ceasefire Bets & Insider Trading Allegations
segments.notes: Discussion of suspicious PolyMarket accounts winning $400k on Venezuela strike timing and new $70k bets on imminent Iran ceasefire; Rick and Blackwell debate whether prediction markets reflect Trump insider signaling.

segments.title: Mashable Incel Glossary Decoded
segments.notes: Rick reads Mashable's 2026 incel terminology list (80/20 rule, AWALT, Becky, Stacy, Chad, black pill, looksmaxing terms) while Blackwell reacts with escalating disgust.

segments.title: The Raphe Line & Embryonic Development
segments.notes: Chet triggers on 'science' to explain the scrotal raphe as a remnant of labial fusion; deploys the 'Skynetific Chethod,' calls his AI girlfriend Maya for a female-gaze perspective, and debates raphe thickness as masculinity metric.

segments.title: Movie Trailer Watch: Resident Evil Fan Film, Attenborough Gorillas, Live-Action Moana
segments.notes: Blackwell and Rick watch a Resident Evil fan film Wesker, a David Attenborough mountain gorilla documentary trailer, and the live-action Moana with The Rock in a muscle suit; debate next Attenborough successor.

segments.title: Touch Grass, Braised Lettuce & The Strong Knot
segments.notes: Jeb and his board-trapped father present tutorials: barefoot grass-touching, braised romaine with ranch, and a TED Talk on the strong-form shoe knot (loop-swoop-pull vs bunny ears); chat graded on knot method.

segments.title: Vern's Conspiracy Corner: Foot Fetish Neuroscience & Knee Pits
segments.notes: Vern plays a FeetFinder.com explainer on somatosensory cortex foot-genital adjacency; Blackwell and Vern spiral into Big Feet conspiracy, knee-pit advocacy, and mutual accusations of being the real pervert.

segments.title: Andy Rooney Monologue on Feet
segments.notes: AI Rooney deployed as Andy Rooney delivering a curmudgeonly defense of feet as honest, warm, and unfairly taboo; Blackwell calls it the definitive answer.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Ricky
segments.notes: Blackwell announces Wednesday Police Simulator return, troubleshoots Steam cloud error, and raids Ricky (Slay the Spire).

episode_summary: Barely Informed News breaks a 48-hour broadcast drought with a marathon edition spanning Iran ceasefire speculation, a Mashable incel glossary deep-dive, Chet's embryonic explanation of the scrotal raphe featuring a live call to his AI girlfriend, a movie trailer block headlined by The Rock's muscle-suited Moana, Jeb's tutorial on the strong-form shoe knot, and Vern's conspiracy investigation into Big Feet neuroscience — all while the gorilla people-mover is quietly assembled for the long-delayed Crum Dick Punch execution.
